visual.general_description: Three color close-up eye photographs labelled A, B and C, each with a black arrow pointing to a pale tube-like structure on red conjunctiva.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Color close-up of an eye with dark vignetted corners. The conjunctiva is diffusely red with many fine branching vessels, and several small whitish patches lie in the upper part. A pale gray, translucent, elongated tube-like structure runs diagonally on the surface to the right of centre, and a black arrow at its lower right points to it. A dark gray rounded area with a darker centre lies at the lower left. The upper eyelid margin with whitish bumps is at the upper right. The letter A in a black circle is at the upper left. No scale bar, ruler or measurement is visible. Panel B: Color close-up of an eye with dark vignetted corners. The left of the field is pale conjunctiva crossed by red branching vessels with a small whitish patch. A pale diagonal tube-like structure lies right of centre, and a black arrow at its lower end points to it. A dark gray rounded area with a darker centre lies in the lower centre-left, with eyelashes and the lower lid margin along the bottom. The letter B in a black circle is at the upper left. No scale bar, ruler or measurement is visible. Panel C: Color close-up that appears to be at higher magnification than panels A and B, with the field filled by red conjunctiva and fine branching vessels. Whitish patches lie in the upper left. A pale gray translucent tube-like structure runs diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right, and a black arrow below it points to it. Part of a dark gray region is at the lower left corner, the upper eyelid margin with whitish bumps is at the upper right, and a few small white specks lie at the lower right. The letter C in a black circle is at the upper left. No scale bar, ruler or measurement is visible.

visual.general_description: Two color close-up eye photographs labelled A and B with retracted lids, each showing an oval area at the centre marked by a black arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Color close-up of an eye with the lids retracted and a pale pinkish streak at the upper left corner. At the centre a pale pinkish translucent oval patch with thin dark thread-like lines, some forming angular zigzag shapes, lies over red conjunctival tissue. A black arrow at the lower right edge of the patch points to it. A dark gray region lies at the lower left. Eyelid skin with eyelashes is at the upper right, with bright white glare spots in several places. The letter A in a black circle is at the upper left, and a narrow white strip borders the right edge. No scale bar or measurement is visible. Panel B: Color close-up of an eye with the lids retracted. At the centre a smooth pale pink to orange oval area with soft edges lies over red conjunctival tissue, and no dark thread-like lines are visible on it. A black arrow at its lower right edge points to it. Small whitish patches are scattered at the left, a dark gray region lies at the lower left, the upper lid with white glare spots is at the top right and eyelashes are at the lower right. The letter B in a black circle is at the upper left, and a narrow white strip borders the left edge. No scale bar or measurement is visible.
